evidence.note: Shows that reasoning-oriented RL fine-tuning of LLMs significantly increases hallucination, traces this to high-variance gradients, entropy-induced randomness and spurious local optima, and proposes Factuality-aware Step-wise Policy Optimization (FSPO) to reduce hallucination while improving reasoning accuracy.
evidence.title: Reasoning Models Hallucinate More: Factuality-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models
